hook_en: Begin this week in His shelter. 🙏
reflect_en: Whatever this week holds, you don't have to face it out in the open. The one who dwells in the shelter of the Most High can say with confidence, You are my refuge and my fortress, and start Monday resting in the shadow of the Almighty.
q_en: What are you trusting God with as this week begins?
x_en: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
tiktok: Start your week in His shelter 🙏 Psalm 91:1–2 — He is my refuge and my fortress
yt_title: You Are My Refuge and My Fortress | Psalm 91:1–2 #Shorts
li_open: Strong leaders know where they go for shelter.
li_quote: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
li_body: The psalmist's security didn't come from his own strength but from where he chose to dwell: in the shelter of the Most High. Leaders who start the week in prayer, and give their people a safe place to bring their needs, lead from trust instead of fear.
hook_es: Comienza la semana bajo Su abrigo. 🙏
reflect_es: Sea lo que sea que traiga esta semana, no tienes que enfrentarlo a la intemperie. El que habita al abrigo del Altísimo puede decir con confianza: Esperanza mía, y castillo mío, y comenzar este lunes descansando bajo la sombra del Omnipotente.
q_es: ¿Qué le estás confiando a Dios al comenzar esta semana?
x_es: Diré yo a Jehová: Esperanza mía, y castillo mío; mi Dios, en él confiaré.
key_en: You are my refuge and my fortress
